One of the windiest spots in the world						</span></h3><p class="elementor-icon-box-description">

<svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-eicon-chevron-right" viewBox="0 0 1000 1000" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M696 533C708 521 713 504 713 487 713 471 708 454 696 446L400 146C388 133 375 125 354 125 338 125 325 129 313 142 300 154 292 171 292 187 292 204 296 221 308 233L563 492 304 771C292 783 288 800 288 817 288 833 296 850 308 863 321 871 338 875 354 875 371 875 388 867 400 854L696 533Z"></path></svg></div></div></div></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-8912772 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-parent" data-id="8912772" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container"><div class="elementor-element elementor-element- elementor-widget elementor-widget-html" data-id="" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="html.default"><div class="elementor-widget-container"><section class="kmg" style="max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:56px 20px;color:#0f1f35;font-size:17px;line-height:1.65"><h2 style="font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,38px);line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 16px">Kitesurfing in Madagascar: everything you need to know before you go</h2><p class="gt-block">Kitesurfing <strong>in Madagascar</strong> means sailing in one of the windiest spots in the Indian Ocean, at the island's tip, in Sakalava Bay, near Diego Suarez. Kitesurfing <strong>in Madagascar</strong> offers everything riders could want: consistent wind, a large, flat lagoon for safe progression, and waves breaking off the reef. <a href="https://sakalava.com/en/le-lodge/">Sakalava Lodge</a> is located right on the spot and houses the country's first IKO kitesurfing school, which opened in 2005.</p><h3 style="margin:28px 0 8px">When is the best time to go kitesurfing in Madagascar?</h3><p class="gt-block">The kitesurfing season in Madagascar runs from April to November, with winds gradually increasing until the heart of the southern winter. To choose the right month for your skill level, consult our guide <a href="https://sakalava.com/en/blog/quand-partir-kitesurfer-a-madagascar/">to when to go kitesurfing in Madagascar</a> and our <a href="https://sakalava.com/en/blog/kitesurf-madagascar-guide/">kitesurfing guide to Madagascar</a>.</p><h3 style="margin:28px 0 8px">Why choose Sakalava Bay for your kitesurfing holiday in Madagascar?</h3><p class="gt-block">The Sakalava Bay spot combines <a href="https://sakalava.com/en/blog/le-meilleur-spot-de-kitesurf-a-madagascar/">exceptional wind conditions</a> with easy logistics: bungalows, equipment, and a school are all just steps from the water. You can also try <a href="https://sakalava.com/en/wingfoil/">wingfoiling</a> during the same stay, and our article <a href="https://sakalava.com/en/blog/kitesurf-ou-wingfoil-comment-choisir/">"Kitesurfing vs. Wingfoil: How to Choose"</a> will help you decide.</p><h3 style="margin:28px 0 8px">An all-inclusive kitesurfing holiday in Madagascar</h3><p class="gt-block">Our packages include beachfront accommodation, full board, open bar, gym access, and, depending on the package, unlimited equipment. Find the details of <a href="https://sakalava.com/en/blog/sejour-kitesurf-wingfoil-tout-inclus/">what's included in an all-inclusive kitesurfing holiday</a> and all prices on our <a href="https://sakalava.com/en/tarifs-sakalava/">2027 kitesurfing rates</a> page.</p><h2 id="cours-individuels-ou-stage-illimite" style="font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,32px);line-height:1.2;margin:40px 0 16px">Individual lessons or unlimited training: which option to choose?</h2><p>At Sakalava Lodge, all kitesurfing lessons are 100% private: an IKO instructor just for you, who adapts each session to your level and the day's conditions. The difference lies in the package. In the packages that include it, the course, equipment, and coaching are available without any time limits: you can kitesurf as much as the wind and your fitness allow.</p><ul><li><strong>Beginner :</strong> The initiation package accompanies you from your first piloting to the waterstart and then to your first outings, in private lessons.</li><li><strong>In progress:</strong> You follow up with sessions with your instructor to refine your technique and gain autonomy, at your own pace.</li><li><strong>Autonomous rider:</strong> You ride with your own equipment or that of the center, and you can add Big Air, Freestyle or Wave coaching.</li></ul><p class="gt-block">What is included depends on the package chosen: compare them on the <a href="https://sakalava.com/en/tarifs-sakalava/">2027 kitesurfing holiday prices and packages</a> page , then <a href="https://sakalava.com/en/contact-booking/">send us your dates and your level</a> to receive a suitable proposal.</p><h2 style="font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,32px);line-height:1.2;margin:40px 0 16px">Frequently asked questions about kitesurfing in Madagascar</h2><div style="margin:0 0 18px"><h3 style="font-size:19px;margin:0 0 6px">Where to go kitesurfing in Madagascar?</h3><p style="margin:0">The best kitesurfing spot in Madagascar is Sakalava Bay, in Diego Suarez (Antsiranana), in the far north of the island. Consistent wind, shallow lagoon for learning, waves off the reef for experienced kitesurfers: this is where Sakalava Lodge and its IKO Pro Kite School are located.</p></div><div style="margin:0 0 18px"><h3 style="font-size:19px;margin:0 0 6px">What is the best time for kitesurfing in Madagascar?</h3><p style="margin:0">The kitesurfing season in Madagascar runs from April to November. At Sakalava Bay, the wind blows 20 to 25 knots in April and November, 25 to 32 knots in May and October, and 30 to 35 knots and more from June to September, with approximately 95% of days being rideable during the season.</p></div><div style="margin:0 0 18px"><h3 style="font-size:19px;margin:0 0 6px">Is it possible to learn kitesurfing in Madagascar starting from scratch?</h3><p style="margin:0">Yes. Our IKO kitesurfing school, operating since 2005, offers 100% individual lessons, from the first time you've piloted the kite to waterstarts and then your first rides, in French, English, or Malagasy. Equipment is included as much as you like.</p></div><div style="margin:0 0 18px"><h3 style="font-size:19px;margin:0 0 6px">What does a kitesurfing holiday in Madagascar at Sakalava Lodge include?</h3><p style="margin:0">The all-inclusive stay includes a beachfront bungalow, full board, and an open bar. Depending on the package chosen, it may also include unlimited kitesurfing and/or wingfoiling (equipment, lessons, or coaching depending on the offer). IKO certification is offered to eligible students at the end of their stay.</p></div><div style="margin:0 0 18px"><h3 style="font-size:19px;margin:0 0 6px">How much does a kitesurfing trip to Madagascar cost?</h3><p style="margin:0">Our all-inclusive 2027 packages start at €680 for 3 days/3 nights in a single bungalow, €1,400 per week for one person, and €2,400 per week for two people practicing kitesurfing in a double bungalow. Independent riders can stay from €130 per night.</p></div><div style="margin:0 0 18px"><h3 style="font-size:19px;margin:0 0 6px">Should you bring your kitesurfing equipment to Madagascar?</h3><p style="margin:0">No, it's not necessary: ​​the center has a complete and updated range (Airush range, Naish Expert 2027 range for rent).
